newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police detain two in Coke blackmail case.
newsitem.headline: German police detain two in Coke blackmail case.

text.p: Police have seized two men suspected of attempted extortion against Coca-Cola Company bottlers by threatening to poison some of the soft drink giant's best known products, a police spokesman said on Friday.
The men, both in their thirties, were detained on Thursday and several crates of drinks taken into custody, the spokesman in the northern town of Hildesheim said.
They had threatened to contaminate Coca-Cola, Fanta and Sprite drinks across Germany unless the company paid them several million marks, police said.
The Hannoversche Allgemeine Zeitung newspaper quoted police as saying the blackmailers' methods were "not very professional" and that consumers were never in serious danger.
